scripts.start: rm -rf dist/toolkit dist/dynamic-view dist/dynamic-view-test && concurrently -n toolkit,dv,dvt,app -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "ng build toolkit --watch" "ng build dynamic-view --watch" "wait-on dist/dynamic-view/package.json && ng build dynamic-view-test --watch" "wait-on dist/toolkit/package.json dist/dynamic-view-test/package.json && ng serve rw-webui --host $(hostname)"
scripts.build: ng build toolkit && ng build dynamic-view && ng build dynamic-view-test && ng build rw-webui
